instruction: Use `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scene.blend`. Keep `Terrain` as a mesh with its existing FLOAT attribute `density`, keep `Tree` as a mesh object, and give `Terrain` exactly one modifier, a Geometry Nodes modifier. Save as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.blend`. The node group must contain a `Distribute Points on Faces` node with distribute method `POISSON` and Seed 42, and an `Instance on Points` node. The evaluated depsgraph must expose true instances parented to `Terrain` with a total count between 30 and 500, and every instance must have world-space `x >= -0.1`.
source: Bridson 2007 — "Fast Poisson Disk Sampling in Arbitrary Dimensions", SIGGRAPH Sketches
